Head_and_Face: Head is broad and heavy with a pronounced occiput and square muzzle.
Ears are thick, lobular, and set at eye level, covered with wavy hair.
Eyes are large, hazel, and set wide apart with a soft, melancholy expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is long, low, and massive with a short neck and deep chest.
Coat is abundant, flat, and slightly wavy in distinctive golden liver color.
Coat has heavy feathering on chest, legs, and belly.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is docked and carried level with moderate feathering.
Short legs and massive build are distinctive features.

Head_and_Face: Head is long with a nearly Roman nose and strong jaws.
Ears are long, set low, and covered with long, curly hair.
Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark hazel with an alert, intelligent expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is sturdy and well-muscled with a deep chest and level topline.
Coat is heavy, dense, liver-colored curls covering the body.
Distinctive topknot of long, loose curls on the head.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is nearly hairless (rat tail), thick at the base and tapering to a fine point.

Head_and_Face: Head is moderately broad with a slightly domed skull and wedge-shaped muzzle.
Ears are V-shaped, pendant, and set moderately high.
Eyes are dark brown, almond-shaped, and set at a slight angle with an alert, intelligent expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is athletic and well-muscled with a slightly arched loin and deep chest.
Coat is dense, white double coat that is wavy to straight.
Coat is medium to long with a coarse outer coat and fine, woolly undercoat.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is carried low with a slight upward curve at the tip.
Imposing size and white coat are distinctive features.

Head_and_Face: Head is fox-like with a broad skull tapering to a pointed muzzle.
Ears are small, triangular, erect, and set high.
Eyes are dark brown, small, and oval with a mischievous, alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is compact, square-proportioned, and sturdy.
Coat is abundant double coat forming a ruff around the neck.
Coat is straight, harsh-textured, black, and stands off from the body.
Shorter hair on the face, ears, and legs.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is naturally short or docked, carried high.

Head_and_Face: Head is clean-cut with a flat skull and tapering muzzle.
Ears are triangular, stiff, erect, and set high.
Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with an intelligent, alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is elegant, well-muscled, and square-proportioned.
Coat is solid black, long, abundant double coat.
Coat is dense and straight with shorter hair on head and front-of-legs.
Abundant ruff around the neck and heavily plumed tail.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is long and carried low.

Head_and_Face: Head is clean-cut with a flat skull and parallel lines of skull and muzzle.
Ears are triangular, stiff, erect, and set high.
Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with an intelligent, alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is athletic, well-muscled, and square-proportioned with a level topline.
Coat is dense, straight double coat in rich fawn to mahogany.
Distinctive black overlay and black mask on the face.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is medium-length, strong at the base, and carried low with a slight upward curve.

Head_and_Face: Head is long with a broad skull and square muzzle.
Ears are set high, cropped or natural, and covered with long hair.
Eyes are large, oval, and dark with an intelligent, alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is powerful and well-proportioned with a level topline and deep chest.
Coat is long, wavy, slightly stiff in black, tawny, or gray.
Coat is abundant, dry, and falls naturally with a distinctive beard, mustache, and eyebrows.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is long, well-feathered, and carried low with a slight upward curve (j-hook).

Head_and_Face: Head is fox-like with a broad skull and tapering muzzle.
Ears are pointed, erect, and set wide apart with a slight outward tilt.
Eyes are oval, dark brown, and alert with an intelligent, keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is athletic, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline.
Coat is short, dense double coat in black, black-and-tan, red, red-and-tan, fawn, or cream.
Coat is weather-resistant with a soft undercoat and harsh outer coat.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is moderately long, straight, and carried low.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad with a moderate skull and strong muzzle.
Ears are pendant, V-shaped, and set moderately high, hidden within the cords.
Eyes are dark brown, medium-sized, and set at a slight angle with an alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is massive, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall.
Coat forms long, dense cords that hang to the ground, resembling dreadlocks.
Coat is entirely white, providing protection from weather and predators.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is carried low with a slight upward curve.

Head_and_Face: Head is large and square with a bear-like gait.
Ears are small, pendant, and carried flat against the head.
Eyes are dark or pearl (wall eyes), set under a shaggy brow.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is compact, square-proportioned, and well-muscled with a distinctive roly-poly appearance.
Coat is profuse, shaggy double coat in bluish-grey and white.
Coat is harsh-textured, not straight, and abundant throughout with a dense, waterproof undercoat.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Tail is traditionally docked, giving the breed its bobtail nickname.
